Correto. The juxtaglomerular apparatus, located at the vascular pole of the renal corpuscle, is composed of the macula densa of the distal convoluted tubule and the juxtaglomerular cells of the afferent arteriole. The macula densa, a region of tightly packed cells in the distal convoluted tubule, lies adjacent to the juxtaglomerular cells (modified smooth muscle) of the afferent arteriole.

Correto. Proximal straight tubules have a tall cuboidal epithelium, regular arrangement of nuclei around the tubule and a brush border (obscured here by the luminal contents). Ascending thick tubules are lined by a lower cuboidal epithelium with irregularly spaced nuclei that frequently bulge into the lumen. Collecting tubules have columnar epithelia with conspicuous lateral cell boundaries.
